pr.title: Add opt-in volume cleanup to aspire stop
pr.author: danegsta

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost.Tests, Hosting.RemoteHost, Hosting.RemoteHost, tests/Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost...) / Hosting.RemoteHost (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: The 'Build test project' step failed with a generic exit code 1 and job logs were unavailable ('Failed to fetch logs for job'). The PR does not touch anything related to Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost.Tests or its dependencies. This matches a previously identified recurring infrastructure issue where 'Build test project' fails across multiple unrelated jobs simultaneously (13 prior occurrences).

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Acquisition.Tests, Acquisition, Acquisition, tests/Aspire.Acqui...) / Acquisition (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: The test PRScriptShellTests.BooleanFlags_AreAccepted failed due to a race condition where the mock 'gh' binary used in the test is executed while it's still being written to disk ('Text file busy'). This is unrelated to the PR's changes (which touch Aspire.Cli StopCommand and Aspire.Hosting Dcp code, not the acquisition scripts or test infrastructure) and matches a known recurring flaky test pattern.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure, tests/Aspire...) / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: AzureServiceBusExtensionsTests.AzureServiceBusEmulatorResourceGeneratesConfigJsonOnlyChangedProperties failed with a TaskCanceledException during DistributedApplication.StopAsync host shutdown. This is an emulator resource teardown timing issue unrelated to the PR's changes (which touch Aspire.Cli StopCommand and Aspire.Hosting Dcp code, not Azure Service Bus). Matches a known recurring flaky test pattern.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: The 'Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone' test timed out after ~295s waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session for the Blazor WASM root to attach. The PR does not touch the VS Code extension or Blazor debugging code at all (it only modifies Aspire.Cli StopCommand and Aspire.Hosting Dcp/volume cleanup code). This matches a known recurring flaky pattern where the browser-debugger E2E shard intermittently times out waiting for the WASM debug session to become interactive.
